data.fixed_clause: Upon successful account registration and profile creation, the user may opt in to receive commercial communications, promotional offers, and updates originating from the application administration as well as our designated corporate partners. Communication preferences require prior consent to maintain outreach, and direct opt-out functionalities are provided in user notification settings.
